title: BindsNET: Open-source SNN simulation framework
summary: Created in 2018 by Hazan Hananel and Daniel Saunders with DARPA support, BindsNET is an open-source computational framework for simulating spiking neural networks (SNNs) built on PyTorch. It supports various neuron models, learning algorithms, and synaptic connections while leveraging GPU/CPU acceleration. The tool allows customization of weights and time-steps but requires familiarity with PyTorch.
tldr: BindsNET is a 2018 open-source framework for simulating spiking neural networks built on PyTorch, supported by DARPA funding.
evidence: BindsNET is an open-source computational framework designed to simulate spiking neural networks (SNNs).
Built atop the PyTorch deep learning library, it was created in 2018 by Hazan Hananel and Daniel Saunders.
Their work is supported by a Defense Advanced Research Project Agency Grant they acquired.
